title: Hum Akber e Jarrar ke Matam Me Jiyeingey
body:
Hum akber e jarrar ke matam me jiyeingey
Seene pa haath maar ke shadab kahengey
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
1.Yeh na soncha tha maaa ne jaan teri jayegi
Jaan teri jayegi....jaan teri jayegi...(jawab)
Is jawani me beta mout tujh ko aayegi
Mout tujh ko aayegi...mout tujh ko aayegi...(jawab)
Maa jiyegi ab kyun ker...ya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Ek teri maa hai Zainab ek teri maa hai laila
Ek teri maa hai laila.....ek teri maa hai laila.... (jawab)
Dono maaoun ne yeh gham ek bete ka paya
Ek bete ka paya....ek bete ka paya.... (jawab)
Rooorahi hai do madar...ya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Aye mere akber tujh ko Karbala na raas aayi
Karbala na raas aayi....Karbala na raas aayi....(jawab)
Daag hai maa ke dil per barchi joh tune khayi
Barchi joh tune khayi....barchi joh tune khayi....(jawab)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum huwe qurbaa’n deen per....ya akber ya akber
4.Chand sa hasee’n chehra tere ghunggar wale baal
Tere ghunggar wale baal....tere ghunggar wale baal....(jawab)
Tere bachpan ki yaadein aur jawani ke woh saal
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa bhulaaye gi kyun ker....ya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Hum se joh takrayega khaak me mil jayega
Khaak me mil jayega....khaak me mil jayega....(jawab)
Hum ko quld jaane se koun rok payega
Koun rok payega....koun rok payega....(jawab)
Hum jo jayeinge kehkar ya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Muntazir jo sughra hai kaise chain payegi
Kaise chain payegi....kaise chain payegi....(jawab)
Mout ki khaber teri sunkay ke woh mar jayegi
Sunkay ke woh mar jayegi....sunkay ke woh mar jayegi....(jawab)
Ji na payegi qwahar....ya akbeer ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Maa ki aur bete ki bekasi huwi zaher
Bekasi huwi zaher....bekasi huwi zaher....(jawab)
Hai tera sar naize par maa khadi hai be-chader
Maa khadi hai be-chader....maa khadi hai be-chader.... (jawab)
Koun roye ab kis per....ya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Hum dua e zehra hai aur sipah e akber hai aur sipah e akber hai....aur sipah e akber hai....(jawab)
Matami hai akber ke aur ghulaam e Sarwar
Ghulaam e Sarwar hai....ghulaam e Sarwar....(jawab)
Yeh likha hai seenou per....ya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
9.Shaaan se hum jeete hai shaan se marjayeinge
Shaan se marjayeinge....shaan se marjayeinge....(jawab)
Puchne ko turbat me jab malaik aayeinge
Jab malaik aayeinge....jab malaik aayeinge....(jawab)
Hum uthengey yeh kehkar....ya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
10.Dekhker tere sar ko yaad aata hai sehra
Yaad aata hai sehra....yaad aata hai sehra....(jawab)
Aankh bandh karti hoon yaad aata hai chehra
Yaad aata hai chehra....yaad aata hai chehra....(jawab)
Aansoun ke hai lab perya akber ya akber
<<MINI>>
Aye shabih e paighamber ya akber ya akber
Hashr tak rahe lab per ya akber ya akber
<<DIVIDER>>
Azz..rehan shadaab
